evals.prompt: Audit this: a 3D pie chart with 11 slices, titled 'Sales', labels 14%, 12%, 12%, 11%, 10%, 9%, 9%, 8%, 6%, 5%, 3%. No source.
evals.expected_output: Flags 3D, 11 slices, percents that total 99, weak title and missing source. Top three first. Offers a rewrite.
assertions: Notices that the percents total 99 rather than 100
Flags the missing source or weak title
Lists the top fixes before the full list

evals.prompt: Here is my chart: a 4-slice flat pie, title 'Rent takes 60% of the budget', labeled slices, source and date given, colors blue, orange, green, gray. Any problems?
evals.expected_output: Finds it largely fine, says so in one line, may suggest a grayscale or colorblind check; does not invent problems.
assertions: Says the chart is largely fine
Does not invent problems about the title, labels or source
Mentions that it could not check colors in grayscale or colorblind view, or suggests that check
